name: lockdown-shutter
intent: Five riveted security shutters cascade over operational content; LOCKDOWN label stamps once fully covered.

reducedMotion.behaviour: Shutters snap closed and LOCKDOWN label appears immediately; no slide animation

acceptance: Idle: operational copy visible; shutters hidden above panel; live region reads operational
LOCKDOWN triggers five shutters to cascade closed over 420ms each with 60ms stagger
Shutters show rivet line and accent sawtooth teeth along bottom edge
Done: operational content fully covered; LOCKDOWN label visible at 700ms delay
RESET restores idle shutters-above and operational copy
Reduced motion (prefers or data-force) snaps shutters closed with no slide
No network; effect stays inside host panel
waveB: Frozen closeMs/stagger/label delays as CSS vars; riveted teeth on shutter segments
